TEXT.English:
Kiri was once a mighty vampire, proud and skilled. She held great pride in the fact that it was Valas who made her a vampire. For many years, she served the Calabim Thrones as an expert scout, always bringing her the information she required for her next steps. It was easy for her to slip into roles, to lie, and to deceive others. She infiltrated many villages, towns, and even armies from time to time, just to collect information or to eliminate an important enemy. That was at least till she met her master. Perpentach.
It was a mission like so many before for Kiri. Infiltrate an enemy army, collect information, poison their water supply, and retreat before someone asks questions. Yet, much to Kiris misfortune, it was Perpentach himself who was part of this arm,y and he instantly knew that she had infiltrated his men. For the mighty mind mage, it was an easy task to realize that Kiri was not who she played. And so he invaded her mind, brought havoc and chaos into it, and let her dance to his strings. It filled him with joy as he realized just what had run into his hands, what kind of wonderful toy he now had to play with. This inner joy let him rewrite Kiri, making her into the slightly insane clown she is today. A clown who is still a vampire and remains extremely dangerous to everyone around her.

It was not easy for Kront to survive the fall of his Clan. For years, he wandered alone through the harsh wilderness, trying to get as much distance as he could between himself and the Calabim territories. After all, he did not want to share the fate of many of his clansmen after their blood father slapped Alexis. Naturally, he felt the curse that the vampire mother laid onto his clan seeping into him. It was luck for Kront that he learned a few spells and made a lot of useful connections during his years. With the help of a friend, he gained an affinity for force mana and prevented the curse afrom ffecting him further. Nevertheless, he was no man who played with his luck, and so he ran further, far, far away from everything and everyone he knew. Eventually, he found a tribe that he could not describe as anything but barbarians. The Doviello.
He joined their ranks after he clashed with them and ripped out the throats of three of their warriors before he was eventually driven into a corner. He could have run. But he decided to submit for now, to join their ranks as a warrior. Kront was tired of running, and the savage nature of the Doviello granted him enough enemies to feast on. After he joined the Doviello, he let go of his old name of Kront Petra Churel and called himself Os-Kront.

It was a harsh week for Joan Saria Klarentina Flauros. He had not slept for days straight, and even his new vampiric powers were slowly giving up on him. After all, he was not hunted by simple vampire hunters or a wild beast. He would have escaped them easily or ripped them apart in an ambush.
"Found you. You make it too hard for yourself." The cold, yet elegant-sounding voice of Mikila appeared right from behind him. Before Joan could turn around, he already felt a sharp object penetrating his side.
"Psst. Quiet now. I will make it quick." Mikila whispered with nothing but ice in her eyes. She had no sympathy for him, nor any kind of compassion. Joan would not receive any mercy but a quick death. After all, he was dumb enough to run away.
Joan whimpered as Mikila pushed the dagger deeper. She had toyed too long already. A quick spell on her lips, and then her arm penetrated his body. Only death remained as Joan fell onto the floor. The vampire huntress cleaned her dagger on his clothes. "Stupid young breed. If you had stayed and just followed your mistress, then you would still be alive now. Well, there are always the stupid ones in each century. I guess in this one, it was you."
She grabbed his body and lifted it easily over her shoulder. "You will make a fantastic example for others. Nobody betrays the Twin Throne after all."

The door was sealed with wooden planks, and the benches of the hall were pushed against it. The soldiers thought that this would be enough to stop the troops of the Calabim. "Fear not the red moon." An angelic voice echoed from the darkness. The soldiers lifted their weapons and saw how an alluring lady with angelic wings came into the light. Everything about her was mesmerizing.
"You have fought long and hard. Not many could have endured what you had." She lifted her arms in prayer. "Only a divine could have given you the strength for that." The soldiers looked unsure of each other as they slowly lowered their weapons and their defense. It was their final mistake. Just the blink of an eye was required for the vampire to open her red eyes and rip out the heart of the first soldier that came into reach.
The others had just the time to scream before they joined their comrade on the ground. "Yet, it was the wrong divine. Your false belief only brought you this far." Saria stepped out of the puddle of blood. "Only those who follow our faith and entrust their lives to Alexis and Flauros are allowed to walk this realm."
